styles.personaRule: Resolve PERSONA_ID for visible characters; treat hand/pen overlay separately.
styles.cameraRule: Use subtle pan/zoom only after major draw steps.
styles.actionRule: Reveal only narration-relevant stroke paths; keep completed sketch fixed.
styles.subtitleRule: Phrase-level sync; avoid the active drawing region.

styles.personaRule: Keep cooking host PERSONA_ID consistent across all character shots.
styles.cameraRule: Alternate medium character, overhead ingredient, and macro food closeup shots.
styles.actionRule: Use realistic cooking hand actions for instructional steps.
styles.subtitleRule: Use short ingredient/action labels in safe margins.

styles.personaRule: Use 2-3 stable PERSONA_IDs with consistent relationship, speech style and reactions.
styles.cameraRule: Use medium two-shot, reaction closeup, then a calm final hold.
styles.actionRule: Drive the message through dialogue and reaction rather than lecture.
styles.audioRule: Dialogue first; reflective narration only in final 10-20 percent.
styles.subtitleRule: Dialogue subtitles plus one concise final reflection line.
